patterns.note: Full-bleed hero image with a strong left-aligned headline and descriptive text, creating an immediate focal point.
Alternating dark (black/dark grey) and light (white/light grey) background sections to clearly delineate content blocks and provide visual rhythm.
Prominent, large-scale sans-serif headings (Roobert) used for section titles, establishing a clear hierarchy and modern aesthetic.
A high-contrast palette primarily using black, white, and shades of grey, accented by a distinct purple for primary calls-to-action and a subtle blue for informational links.

A multi-stage sticky header system where a top promotional banner and the main navigation bar both become fixed, with the main nav visually transforming (shrinking, gaining a solid background) upon scroll.
Subtle parallax scrolling on the hero background image, adding depth and a dynamic feel to the initial view.
Dedicated 'room configuration' sections using a grid of image cards to illustrate product use cases in various settings.

technique_notes: A sophisticated sticky header implementation where both a top-level announcement bar and the primary navigation bar transition to a fixed position at the top of the viewport. The main navigation bar further animates by reducing its height and changing its background from transparent to opaque white as the user scrolls past the hero.
The hero section incorporates a subtle parallax scrolling effect, where the background image moves at a slower rate than the foreground content, creating a sense of depth.
Content sections below the hero are introduced with a gentle fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport, enhancing engagement and guiding the user's eye, likely using css-keyframes.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, impactful sans-serif headings (~4-5x body text size) with a bold character, paired with clean, readable body text and smaller, often uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle; most elements have sharp corners, but interactive elements like buttons and input fields feature a slight corner radius.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy; generous vertical spacing between major sections, with a more balanced density within content blocks like product cards and feature grids.

standout: The site effectively uses high-quality, authentic photography of diverse people interacting with the product in real-world settings, creating a strong sense of human connection and practical application. The bold, high-contrast typography and clean layout reinforce a professional yet approachable brand identity, making the complex technology feel accessible.
